title: 滲透性反應牆整治
summary: 本課以「由地下水路徑、反應時間與介質老化設計反應牆教學模型」為主軸，依序處理污染羽流與牆位概念、反應介質與可用容量、柱試驗動力學、孔隙堵塞與流速變化、牆內外井網驗證。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Build a reactive-barrier teaching model from groundwater pathways, reaction time and media ageing, progressing through Plume and conceptual barrier position, Reactive medium and usable capacity, Column-test kinetics, Pore clogging and velocity change, Inside/outside monitoring network. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 污染羽流與牆位概念：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Plume and conceptual barrier position: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 污染羽流與牆位概念 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Plume and conceptual barrier position and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先在剖面定位羽流寬深、地下水流向和未污染旁通區，不能只在地表畫一條線稱完整截流。 孔隙平均流速為 Darcy 通量除有效孔隙率；污染遲滯與彌散另需處理。
steps.instructionEn: Locate plume width and depth, groundwater direction and bypass zones in section; a surface line alone does not establish interception. Mean pore-water velocity is Darcy flux divided by effective porosity; retardation and dispersion require separate treatment.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：K=1e-4 m/s；水力梯度 i=0.01；有效孔隙率 ne=0.25。公式 v=K*i/ne*86400，計算得 0.3456 m/d。適用邊界：飽和均質含水層、層流，非裂隙運移預測。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: K=1e-4 m/s; hydraulic gradient i=0.01; effective porosity ne=0.25. Formula v=K*i/ne*86400 gives 0.3456 m/d. Applicability: Saturated homogeneous aquifer and laminar flow; not a fractured-flow prediction.
steps.failure: 把 Darcy 通量直接當孔隙流速會低估移動速度。 在「污染羽流與牆位概念」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Using Darcy flux directly as pore velocity understates travel speed. Mark where this error can enter the Plume and conceptual barrier position flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「污染羽流與牆位概念」，將估算流速與示蹤到達、地層和水頭場比較，列出各參數範圍。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Plume and conceptual barrier position, Compare estimated velocity with tracer arrival, stratigraphy and heads, listing parameter ranges. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.text: 只將 ne 改成 0.20，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.3456 變成 0.432 m/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
knowledge.textEn: Change only ne to 0.20, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.3456 to 0.432 m/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

steps.title: 被動穿流與水力匹配：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Passive flow and hydraulic matching: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 被動穿流與水力匹配 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Passive flow and hydraulic matching and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 比較牆前後水頭及天然梯度，辨識污染水是穿牆、繞牆還是從牆底通過。 水頭差除以距離給指定方向的梯度；單一剖面不能代替三維地下水流場。
steps.instructionEn: Compare heads across the wall and natural gradient to distinguish through-flow from side or underflow bypass. Head difference over spacing gives a directional gradient; one section cannot replace a three-dimensional groundwater field.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：兩點水頭 h1=12.4 m、h2=11.8 m；距離 L=30 m。公式 i=(h1-h2)/L，計算得 0.02 m/m。適用邊界：同一標高基準、同一含水層及同步讀值。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Heads h1=12.4 m, h2=11.8 m; spacing L=30 m. Formula i=(h1-h2)/L gives 0.02 m/m. Applicability: Common elevation datum, same aquifer and synchronized readings.
steps.failure: 不同濾管深度或時間的液位可能產生假的水平梯度。 在「被動穿流與水力匹配」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
